names.ja: ミクロソリウム・ムシフォリウム

light.best.quote: This plant prefers bright indirect light to partial or full shade

light.min.quote: This plant prefers bright indirect light to partial or full shade

light.directSun.quote: The leaves will also scorch if the plant is placed in direct sunlight.

temperature.minC.quote: Avoid exposure to temperatures below 50 degrees Fahrenheit.

humidity.quote: It thrives in environments with high humidity

watering.growing.quote: Water the plant when the soil surface begins to feel dry

watering.winter.reason: 出典に冬の記載がないため、室温が下がると水を吸う量が減ることから一段乾かし気味とした

tips.ja: 葉のふちが茶色いのは湿度不足か水道水が原因。
tips.quote: Brown leaf edges indicate low humidity or result from using tap water.

tips.ja: 春〜夏は月に1回、半分に薄めた液体肥料を与える。
tips.quote: A diluted half strength balanced liquid fertilizer should be used to feed the plant once a month during the spring and summer.
